quotes.text: Bugzilla is the authority for board hierarchy, membership, fields, attachments, completion, assignees, and relations, but its attached Phabricator request flags were empty and `ASSIGNED` bugs could not distinguish review waiting from update waiting. Use one cached `differential.query` status lookup per revision batch; do not fetch revision comments for board placement. [Task 1]
